players.product: BlueBird Block 2 direct-to-cell satellites (custom AST5000 ASIC) and MNO gateway equipment

quarterly_data.signal: AST 8-K (Q2 2026 release and business update): AST received multiple awards from the U.S. Government with an aggregate value of over $125 million supporting multiple national-security applications; Block 2 satellites are expected to deliver peak data rates approaching 200 Mbps; an initial 3,000 digital cells are activated across the continental United States from seven gateways ahead of beta service in 2026, and nearly 50 gateways across five continents are in various stages of completion, installation and planning.
quarterly_data.figure: over $125 million; approaching 200 Mbps; 3,000 digital cells; seven gateways; nearly 50 gateways
